field_policy.archetype_score: round(clamp(core*spec*cap + synergy_bonus, 0, 100)); flexible uses breadth instead of core/spec/cap
field_policy.confidence: min(confidence[a] for a in required anchors) * min(evidence_completeness[a] for a in required anchors), multiplied by spec_unknown_conf when any anchor quality was bounded-null; each factor is within [0, 1] so the product is bounded [0, 1]. flexible uses mean(confidence) * mean(evidence_completeness) over all anchors instead of min.
field_policy.confidence_storage: integer parts per million from the already-six-decimal model confidence using floor(value*1000000+0.5); exact comparison
field_policy.primary_archetype: highest score, ties broken by archetype_keys order
field_policy.secondary_archetype: next highest score; null only if every other score is 0
field_policy.source: pinned Ratings V4 generation system_rating_vector and economy_opportunity only; no public schema reads
field_policy.weighted_key: ((score::bigint * confidence_ppm * completeness_ppm) + 50000000) / 100000000 using non-negative integer division

wide_columns.rule: one explicitly assigned UTC instant per chunk

field_policy.bio_signal_total: sum of biological signal_count over ACTIVE bodies
field_policy.body_count: Ratings V4 loaded_body_count for the same generation/system
field_policy.completeness: minimum of the seven frozen Ratings V4 completeness values
field_policy.confidence: minimum of the seven frozen Ratings V4 confidence values
field_policy.false_flags: false means no positive observation in the pinned canonical generation, not proof of known absence
field_policy.geo_signal_total: sum of geological signal_count over ACTIVE bodies
field_policy.has_biologicals: positive biological signal_count on an ACTIVE canonical body
field_policy.has_geologicals: positive geological signal_count on an ACTIVE canonical body
field_policy.has_rings: positive observation of an ACTIVE canonical RING; asteroid BELT rows do not set this Finder flag
field_policy.has_terraformable: ACTIVE canonical body with terraforming state terraformable/terraformed/terraforming
field_policy.main_star_class: lowest-body_pk Ratings V4 mechanics body explicitly marked is_main_star=true
field_policy.per_type_counts: counts of ACTIVE v3_derived.body_mechanics rows whose normalised body_class matches each Finder type; barycentre/belt-cluster bodies are excluded from body_mechanics and therefore uncounted
field_policy.position: canonical systems x/y/z; cube point is derived from those exact LY coordinates
field_policy.ring_count: ACTIVE canonical RING rows (asteroid BELT rows excluded)
field_policy.star_counts: black_hole/neutron/white_dwarf resolved from body_class or spectral_class; other_star_count = star rows (spectral_class present) minus those three
field_policy.walkable_count: landable ACTIVE bodies with no/absent atmosphere (atmosphere_classification no_atmosphere or null)
field_policy.zero_counts: a 0 count means no positive observation in the pinned canonical generation, not proven absence
